hook: Europe just made browser competition a top priority.
hookText: Browser competition is now a DMA priority

beats.say: The European Commission has declared browser competition a Digital Markets Act priority, acknowledging an open letter from digital rights groups.
Browsers are effectively the entry point to the internet, which is why the campaign argues fair competition there matters so much.
The letter brought together a broad coalition, from Europe's largest digital rights network of over fifty organisations to groups representing two hundred ninety-six thousand journalists.
